name: Risks of Using a Detached-Only ADU Builder for Attached Additions

mainEntity.name: What are the main risks of hiring a contractor who mostly builds detached ADUs for a complex attached ADU addition in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What are the main risks of hiring a contractor who mostly builds detached ADUs for a complex attached ADU addition in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not all ADU experience translates equally to attached additions. Contractors who primarily build detached ADUs on open pads may be less accustomed to the complexities of connecting a new unit to an existing structure. For a complex attached ADU addition in Los Angeles County, this can create several risks. Structural tie‑ins to existing framing and foundations are more intricate than starting from a blank slate and often involve reinforcing older construction, addressing irregular framing, and dealing with previous remodels. Contractors unfamiliar with this may underprice or oversimplify the work, leading to large change orders once walls are opened. Code compliance for fire separation, sound insulation, and egress between the main house and the ADU is more demanding in attached scenarios; missing these requirements can trigger plan check corrections and rework. Working around occupants requires strategies for safety, access, and dust control that ground‑up builders may not have refined. To reduce risk, look for contractors who can show multiple completed attached additions, including over‑garage or side‑yard projects, and ask specifically how those differed from detached builds. Review their scope and contract language for contingencies addressing hidden conditions and integration with existing systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a contractor focused on detached ADUs for a complex attached addition can lead to underestimated structural work, missed code requirements for fire and sound separation, and more change orders. Attached ADUs demand deeper experience with tie‑ins, existing conditions, and occupied remodeling than standalone builds.
